captured_at.description: When the backend froze this immutable Snapshot.

source_timestamp.description: OPC UA / measurement time copied from the Digital Twin. Null means the source time is unknown.

source_timestamp_provenance.description: measurement is a copied equipment clock. unknown is a legacy Snapshot from before this field existed. Do not treat unknown as an OPC UA timestamp.

ingest_timestamp.description: When the backend ingested the live Twin state used for this Snapshot.

source_quality.description: Equipment source quality frozen with the Snapshot. Not FEA numerical quality.

input_quality.description: MEASURED is live equipment quality. SCENARIO_ASSUMED means evaluation is a what-if and must not be read as a verified GOOD reading.
